svc-insaat.title: G4 Investment and Construction Activities
svc-insaat.shortDescription: We provide end-to-end services in concept development, project design and implementation tailored to the needs of healthcare institutions.
paragraphs: At G4, we provide end-to-end services in concept development, project design and implementation tailored to the needs of healthcare institutions. Concept, architectural and implementation projects for hospitals, medical centers, outpatient clinics and healthcare facilities are prepared by our expert teams, and projects are made ergonomic, functional and compliant with the relevant regulations and licensing requirements.

In addition, renovation, refurbishment and transformation projects for existing healthcare facilities are planned professionally, and implementation and construction processes are managed meticulously. G4 serves as a reliable solution partner throughout all stages of healthcare investments, from planning to turnkey delivery.

svc-arac.title: Vehicle Rental Services
svc-arac.shortDescription: We offer reliable, comfortable and economical transportation solutions to our individual and corporate customers.
paragraphs: As G4 Vehicle Rental Services, we offer reliable, comfortable and economical transportation solutions to our individual and corporate customers. With our wide vehicle fleet, we meet your daily, weekly and long-term rental needs with a professional approach.

Our regularly serviced vehicles are delivered to you in line with safety and comfort standards. From business trips to special events, from city use to long journeys, we are with you with vehicle options for every need.
With our customer-satisfaction-focused approach, fast reservation process and competitive pricing policy, we make your vehicle rental experience easy, safe and enjoyable.

svc-tekstil.title: G4 Hospital Textiles
svc-tekstil.shortDescription: We offer professional solutions for the needs of healthcare institutions with high-quality, hygienic and durable hospital textile products.
paragraphs: We offer professional solutions for the needs of healthcare institutions with high-quality, hygienic and durable hospital textile products.

svc-medikal.title: G4 Medical Activities
svc-medikal.shortDescription: At G4, we offer the products, equipment and professional solutions the healthcare sector needs under one roof.
paragraphs: At G4, we offer the products, equipment and professional solutions the healthcare sector needs under one roof. We serve hospitals, medical centers, clinics, outpatient clinics, laboratories and healthcare institutions with our wide product range.

Built on quality, reliability and sustainable service, our company acts as a solution partner in many areas, from medical consumables and hospital textiles to medical devices and the design of healthcare facilities. By closely following developments in the healthcare sector, we aim to offer innovative and cost-effective solutions suited to the needs of institutions.

Thanks to our expert staff and strong supply network, we manage product procurement quickly, reliably and efficiently, contributing to our customers’ operational efficiency. By prioritizing quality standards in every project, we help healthcare services be delivered more safely and more efficiently.
